scope: Independent source, LinkeDOM event/platform-boundary and parsed CSS integration verification of the mobile cinematic display. No production edits by verifier.

groups.name: Display controller
groups.note: 14 top-level tests plus2 nested terminal-race cases.

selectorRegression.description: With browser contains(self)=true, unqualified delegated attributes matched root state. Because root also has mobilePanel, ordinary clicks normally marked the current menu as manually selected; the fullscreen branch was masked. Explicit button selectors prevent both collisions. The initial34 cases did not model this browser semantic; both new fixtures now do.

verified: Browser contains-self semantics: ordinary fields, file picker and play actions do not mark a menu manual, enter fullscreen or dismiss an active view; only real display buttons control it.

Auto narrow/mobileUA/coarse display, landscape desktop-UA iPad detection and wide Windows touch PC control. ManualPC/mobile selection persists and wins over resize; blocked storage and missingmatchMedia remain functional.

One persistent iframe, unchanged authored document, uncommitted caption/time fields, selected target, panel scroll positions and timeline across menu/mode switches. Display controls issue no additional preview-load commands.

Authenticated actor/subtitle selections open the lower inspector without history or scene-command mutations. Existing500ms status polling is controlled at its callback boundary and does not reset the selected menu.

Mobile quick play and fullscreen play/pause use the existing serialized preview command queue and cannot overtake a pending seek. Existing start/interior/end capture, undo/redo and navigation assertions remain covered; this focused run does not re-exhaust the five-entry history limit.

Direct user-gesture native request; native/WebKit fullscreen and orientation outcomes; portrait view-only fallback, landscape restoration, failure/retry, unrelated native owner, late request/lock after exit/destroy, Back, per-document pending Back remount guard, listeners/style/focus cleanup.

Same-origin child-document canvas Escape closes preview without stopPropagation, preserving game cleanup; iframe-load rebind removes old document listener; destroy removes current listener. Rotated stage inert is scoped, removed on landscape/exit and restores a prior inert owner.
Visual viewport844→440→844 height ownership without mode/panel/frame/draft changes; previous inline viewport-height value restored on destroy.

Parsed CSS supports320/390/600/760/1024/1440 widths plus390×440 keyboard case, fixed top preview ownership, one independent lower scroll panel, explicitPC3columns at small widths with horizontal access, safe areas,44px targets,16px fields, bounded file menu/dialogs. Rotated stage alone swaps viewport axes; toolbar remains outside transform; iframe pointer input is blocked only in rotated viewing.

changes: Explicitly scope desktop CSS expectations to the public data-studio-mode contract; preserve original PCcolumns and short-desktop scroll behavior.
Permit intentional play/pause duplicates in separate preview controls while retaining unique other actions/fields/views and all existing authoring behavior assertions.

sourceEvidence.moment: Hashes recorded after the passing focused run; controller/CSS/HTML match final owner-supplied freeze hashes. Parent owns the whole-suite before/after source snapshot.

limits: No browser automation, physical device, real mobile fullscreen permission, orientation lock, soft keyboard or rendered layout pixels were exercised.

Native/WebKit fullscreen, history and orientation are simulated at the platform API boundary around real controller DOM events. CSS cascade/DOM constraints do not establish actual device appearance, touch-coordinate correctness, viewport clipping or browser-specific fullscreen policy.
Tests preserve preview identity and transport behavior but do not create a WebGL Engine or prove GPU/FPS/heat behavior.

Only the two new test files, two explicitly approved existing layout tests and this verification report directory were edited by this verifier. Existing concurrent application/assets work was left untouched.
